package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/openexec/openexec/pkg/execution"
)

// Runs in the overlay that swaps in the reader as it was on main before version
// 4 existed (see execution_stdio_legacy_test.go). The reader is the old code; the
// request is the new caller's, identities included.
func TestLegacyRuntimeRefusesV4Request(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(executionEnvelope{Version: 4, Operation: "execute", Request: &execution.Request{
		ID: "legacy", WorkingDir: t.TempDir(), Prompt: "read it", Sandbox: execution.Sandbox{Mode: execution.SandboxReadOnly},
		ReadableRoots:          []string{"/synthetic/root"},
		ReadableRootIdentities: []execution.ReadableRootIdentity{{Path: "/synthetic/root", Device: 1, Inode: 2}},
	}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// The caller's bytes carry the identity fields; the old reader is handed them
	// whole and refuses the version rather than dropping them.
	if !bytes.Contains(data, []byte(`"ReadableRootIdentities":[{"path":"/synthetic/root","device":1,"inode":2}]`)) {
		t.Fatalf("identity fields are not on the wire: %s", data)
	}
	built := false
	var output bytes.Buffer
	err = serveExecutionProtocol(context.Background(), bytes.NewReader(data), &output, func(context.Context, string, execution.Sandbox, toolGateway) (execution.Provider, error) {
		built = true
		return protocolProvider{}, nil
	})
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unsupported execution protocol version 4") {
		t.Fatalf("legacy reader did not refuse v4: %v", err)
	}
	// The refusal names only the version: no root path or identity value.
	if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "synthetic") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "Inode") {
		t.Fatalf("refusal echoes request content: %v", err)
	}
	if built || output.Len() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("legacy reader did work for a v4 request: built=%v output=%q", built, output.String())
	}
}

// Near miss: the same legacy reader still serves the version it understands.
func TestLegacyRuntimeStillServesV3(t *testing.T) {
	var output bytes.Buffer
	if err := serveExecutionProtocol(context.Background(), strings.NewReader(`{"version":3,"operation":"describe"}`), &output, staticProvider(protocolProvider{})); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(output.String(), `"operation":"describe"`) {
		t.Fatalf("output = %s", output.String())
	}
}
